title: A Page of Spells
description:
Magic does not begin with spectacular damage. It begins with a book, a simple glyph and the ability to combine effects deliberately.

This is an introductory reading entry ONLY. It does not claim the dimension was entered, a boss was defeated, a relic was equipped, or any reward has been earned. Runtime-verified item/structure objectives will be authored later.

Field note: The Field Manual explains glyph syntax step by step. This adventure only tracks the major milestone.
